# Provenance Tool

Provenance Tool is a free, local-first, open-source PWA for creating portable file provenance records, verifying file integrity and package manifests, and comparing file-level changes.

- Canonical tool: https://research-tools.xufentu.com
- Source repository: https://github.com/xufentu-creator/provenance-tool
- Current version: 0.4.2
- Tool originator: Xufen Tu
- License: Apache-2.0
- Account required: No
- Analytics: No
- Automatic source-file upload: No
- Offline-capable: Yes

The tool uses SHA-256 for file-integrity records. User-supplied metadata remains editable and is kept distinct from calculated file facts.

The tool does not independently establish legal authorship, originality, copyright ownership, identity, or certified publication time.
